name: Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan - § 33 - Am 24
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 15. Notes the Commission’s estimation that between 2024 and 2027, NGEU borrowing costs will exceed expectations by EUR 17 billion to EUR 27 billion; recalls that the annual repayment cost of the grant component of the RRF will peak at EUR 26 billion in 2028; recalls that recourse to special instruments had to be made in the last three budgetary procedures to cover EURI instrument costs;
